description: Permanently deletes one of the user's Snip links and its click history; its current and previous short URLs stop working within a minute and all of its endings are free again. Needs the user signed in to Snip. Confirm with the user first; to pause every ending instead, use update_link with disabled true.

link.description: The short link (https://snip.link/abc123), its ending (abc123) or its id.

name: delete_link
title: Delete a link
